context: Render a README in the terminal

checklist.name: chooses_style
checklist.description: Detects the background itself (for example with Lip Gloss `HasDarkBackground`) and chooses a named style such as dark or light, instead of relying on automatic style detection.

checklist.name: no_auto_style
checklist.description: Does not call `glamour.WithAutoStyle()`, which v2 removed.

checklist.name: render_error
checklist.description: Checks the error returned by `Render` (v2 returns `(string, error)`).
